title: Sensitive resource exposure
required_materials: Historical response bodies, application file-read records and host file-access audit logs
Web server/proxy routing configuration and historical generic error-page responses
question: Review historical responses and route exposure settings
support_condition: Records showing that the response contained nonpublic file contents, or that an unauthorized file read or execution occurred.
refutation_condition: Records showing rejection before file access, or processing that returned no sensitive information without reading the target file.
correlation_rule: Prefer native IDs actually present on both sides; otherwise compare time, host, method and route candidates, clock skew, competing matches and shared IPs.
limitations: Bodies and authentication/operation audits are unavailable; internal execution, disclosure and unauthorized logins cannot be confirmed.
Parsing supplied logs does not establish complete collection or investigation of all access.
Current exposure, asset criticality, losses, cost, actual owners and deadlines cannot be determined from access logs.
Engine detections, cases and requests overlap; do not sum them as unique attacks.
